speaker: Mr Leon Perera
text: asked	the Minister for Communications and Information what criteria are used to determine the selection of falsehoods corrected on the Gov Factually website.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
text: This is part of the Government's efforts to ensure Singaporeans have access to accurate information on important matters.

speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
text: Just one supplementary question; maybe this is just a confirmation.

speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
text: The process that Factually follows to decide which issues to talk about, is that process fundamentally about collecting feedback from various Ministries, Government agencies and Statutory Boards?

speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
text: Or has Factually in the past and will it in the future, be open to feedback from other non-government organisations to address on the website?
